screens.title: Party rail
screens.description: A compact roster marks the selected member and keeps lead changes behind an explicit action.

screens.title: Equipment comparison
screens.description: One actor and gear slot are compared at a time, with separate Apply and Cancel controls.

screens.title: Integrated battle stage
screens.description: Turn order and command choices sit inside one layered stage while the actors remain visible.

limitations: Original generated party and plaza are an HD-2D mood study, not official OCTOPATH TRAVELER art or exact characters.
Party names, equipment, turn order, and values are synthetic interface fixtures.
The Web specimen does not run combat, persist state, or export a game-engine scene.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
